chain.title: More Than an Ordinary Barrel
chain.desc: Craft or convert a Sophisticated Barrel using an available recipe. Open its interface and inspect both storage and upgrade slots.

chain.title: Choose the Shape of Your Store
chain.desc: Build a Sophisticated Chest if you prefer chest storage. It is an alternative starting container, not a required stop on the barrel route.

chain.title: Bulk Storage at the Front
chain.desc: Try a Limited Barrel for a material you store in bulk. Learn its front-face interactions and lock behavior before connecting automation.

chain.title: Build a Functional Module
chain.desc: Make an Upgrade Base. Pick a module to solve a real storage problem such as filtering, transfer, compacting or processing.

chain.title: Expand a Busy Container
chain.desc: Upgrade a barrel to Iron using your pack's supported tier path. Existing stored items remain part of the upgraded container's workflow.

chain.title: Make Room for More Production
chain.desc: Upgrade to a Gold Barrel and review your filters. More slots do not prevent an unwanted item from occupying them.

chain.title: A Larger Stockroom
chain.desc: Upgrade the barrel to Diamond for a high-volume section of your base. Keep access to the container while expanding the room around it.

chain.title: Finish the Main Storage Tier
chain.desc: Apply the available Netherite tier upgrade. Check the container's capacity and upgrade slots before assigning its final job.

chain.title: Protect the Storage Assignment
chain.desc: Install a Filter Upgrade and test allowed and rejected items. Clear rules help keep a shared input from mixing incompatible supplies.

chain.title: Transfer Between Neighbors
chain.desc: Configure a Hopper Upgrade to move items on the intended sides. Test the direction of transfer with a small stack first.

chain.title: Compress a Repeating Output
chain.desc: Install a Compacting Upgrade and configure its allowed recipes. Confirm that its output form matches what downstream machines need.

chain.title: Deeper Stacks in the Same Slots
chain.desc: Add a Stack Upgrade where bulk quantity matters more than item variety. Review compatible item stack sizes before filling the container.

chain.title: Bring the Containers Together
chain.desc: Build a Storage Controller and attach supported storage. It provides shared access to the connected containers within the installed mod's connection rules.

chain.title: Connect Across an Empty Section
chain.desc: Use Storage Connectors to bridge the arrangement where another inventory is unnecessary. Keep the path connected to the controller.

chain.title: Reach a Separate Storage Group
chain.desc: Use a Storage Link with the Storage Tool as directed by the mod. This extends the network arrangement without pretending every distant barrel connects automatically.

chain.title: Configure the Network Deliberately
chain.desc: Use the Storage Tool's available modes to configure links and storage behavior. Read its tooltip before applying a mode to several containers.

chain.title: Move the Store Safely
chain.desc: Apply Packing Tape using its documented interaction before moving a filled container. Unpack it afterward so the contents are accessible again.

chain.title: Prove Shared Access Works
chain.desc: Connect several containers, insert different items through the network and retrieve them again. Confirm after the system uses the storage you intended.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches, operational guidance, no collection filler

coverage.scope: Upgradable storage, independent automation modules and a connected storage-controller system.
coverage.limitations: Recipe quantities, enabled content and progression settings may be changed by the installed pack.
coverage.verification_detail: Item models, entity language identifiers, dimension data, recipes and bundled guide text where present were inspected; this is data verification, not a Minecraft playthrough.

notes: Each requires list is intentional. Empty lists are independent entry routes. Links describe guided progression or demonstrated recipe/boss gates, not an assertion that every dependency is a game-enforced lock. Runtime scanning still filters unavailable items and entities.
